+        """Filter members based on imported_members setting.
+        
+        Returns a list of member names, excluding imported members if imported=False.
+        """
+        items = []  # type: List[str]
+        for name in dir(obj):
+            try:
+                value = safe_getattr(obj, name)
+            except AttributeError:
+                continue
+            # For modules, check if the member is defined in the module
+            # For classes, check if the member is defined in the class
+            if imported or getattr(value, '__module__', None) == obj.__name__:
+                items.append(name)
+        return items
